title: Bun streaming orders CSV export
context: Streams an orders CSV export from bun:sqlite; several admins may export at the same time. Per RFC 4180, fields containing a comma, quote or line break are quoted with every inner quote doubled; fields beginning with = + - @ get a ' prefix against formula injection. from/to are YYYY-MM-DD UTC days and the range includes both whole days. created_at is epoch milliseconds; totals are never negative.
code: const db = new Database("shop.db", { readonly: true });
const rows = db.query("SELECT id, customer, email, total_cents, created_at FROM orders WHERE created_at >= ? AND created_at < ? ORDER BY id");
if (url.pathname !== "/export/orders.csv") return new Response("not found", { status: 404 });
if (Number.isNaN(from) || Number.isNaN(to)) return new Response("bad range", { status: 400 });
const r = next.value as { id: number; customer: string; email: string; total_cents: number; created_at: number };

expected.why: String.replace with a string pattern only doubles the first quote; must use replaceAll or /"/g
`to` is the start of the last day and the query uses created_at < ?, so the whole `to` day is excluded; it must be dayStart(to) + DAY_MS
one shared prepared statement is iterated by every export; a concurrent export re-binds and resets it, corrupting the other stream; prepare a statement per request
